data.name: Supernet Technologies Limited
data.description: Supernet Technologies Limited, incorporated on 31 October 1981 as a public limited company under the repealed Companies Act, 1913 (now the Companies Act, 2017), is a subsidiary of Telecard Limited and, following its merger with Supernet Limited in February 2026, operates as an ICT communication services and solutions provider in Pakistan, and in the wider region through its foreign subsidiary.
